title: 第三章 发芽的种子
slug: 我在诡异入侵世界当农场主
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

“哇，好暖和的被窝，超舒服，是幸福的味道，远离讨厌的环境，讨厌的老板同事，感受自由的味道，明天还不用上班，想几点睡就几点睡，想睡到几点就睡到几点，太幸福啦！”

苏妗月小幅度地在床上滚来滚去，不敢动作太大，不然热气就全跑出去了，温暖的被窝给足了她幸福感。

虽然说是可以提升植物生长速度。

“也不知道提高了多少啊，要是就一点点，随便一个作物都要三五个月，那跟没有也差不多。”

“系统，这个天赋我应该怎么使用啊？”

“对着植物集中注意力就好。”

系统的回答速度依旧很快，给了苏妗月一种背后有人的安全感。

只是后面按照系统说的又试了几次，还是没什么感觉，渐渐地，她累了。

苏妗月无意识地看着前面的种子，突然好像发现了什么不对，自己身体里突然出现了一种奇怪的感觉，像是一种力量，这就是木系天赋吗。

她抓住这种感觉，一鼓作气，尝试将这股力量投送到前面的种子上面。

虽然现在能动用的力量很少，但是最起码，她成功了，她能清楚的感觉到自己的力量接触到前面的种子，并且包裹住种子，然后就没有然后了，这股力量消失了。

“啊，就这，这就没啦，我这不是才刚开始嘛，怎么就没了，这还啥也没干呢。”

苏妗月彻底清醒，瞪大了眼睛，不死心，想再来一次，这一次还是按照之前的经验放出自己的力量，温柔包裹住种子，这个时候的种子就像是一个有缝的鸡蛋，这股力量的任务就是找到这条缝，然后探进去，用自己的力量撑开这条缝，放出里面的生物，哦不，是芽。

经过她的再三努力，终于有一个种子在她眼前发芽了，虽然很小，几乎是肉眼不可见，但是确实是发芽了，她能感受到。

“哈哈哈哈哈。”

听着房间里面传出来的笑声，老牛甩着尾巴，清理枯草的速度都加快了。

第一颗种子发芽之后，后面的就顺利很多了，陆陆续续的开始发芽。

在种子冒出米粒大小的嫩芽之后，苏妗月自己也累得不行，本来精力就不行，经过这一番大动作，更是感觉疲惫不已，收回天赋力量，不再关注发芽的种子，开始躺平研究系统。

还没有完成的事情拉扯着她昏昏欲睡的脑子。

“清醒点。”

苏妗月翻了个身，顺着缝隙跑进来的冷空气给她刺激的一激灵，清醒了！

黄瓜到了，种子也发芽了，是时候开启店铺了！

叫个什么名字好呢，就叫月亮农场吧，好听。

有时候取名字就是灵光一闪，至于这一闪，闪出来的是张飞还是诸葛亮你别管。

点击提交，“检测到宿主没有可售卖商品，店铺开启失败。”

“看来这个意思是黄瓜这个Bug卡不了，那就只能指望这些种子了。”

“系统，在吗？”

content_en:
Page (1/3)

"Wow, what a warm bed. It's super comfortable. It's the smell of happiness. I'm away from the annoying environment, annoying bosses and colleagues, and I feel the taste of freedom. I don't have to go to work tomorrow. I can go to bed whenever I want, and sleep until as late as I want. I'm so happy!"

Su Jinyue rolled around on the bed slightly, not daring to move too much, otherwise all the heat would escape. The warm quilt gave her a sense of happiness.

Although it is said that it can increase the growth rate of plants.

"I don't know how much the improvement has been. If it's just a little bit, it would take three to five months for any crop, which is almost as good as nothing."

"System, how should I use this talent?"

"Just focus on the plants."

The system's response speed was still very fast, giving Su Jinyue a sense of security that there was someone behind her.

But after trying it a few more times according to the system's instructions, she still felt nothing. Gradually, she became tired.

Su Jinyue looked at the seeds in front of her unconsciously, and suddenly she seemed to notice something was wrong. A strange feeling suddenly appeared in her body, like a kind of power. Could this be the wood talent?

She grabbed this feeling, worked hard, and tried to project this power to the seed in front of her.

Although there is very little power she can use now, at least she succeeded. She could clearly feel her power touching the seed in front of her and wrapping it, and then nothing happened, the power disappeared.

"Ah, that's it, it's gone. I just started. Why is it gone? I haven't done anything yet."

Su Jinyue was completely awake, her eyes widened, and she didn't want to give up. She wanted to do it again. This time she released her power according to her previous experience and gently wrapped the seed. The seed at this time was like an egg with a crack. The task of this power was to find the crack, then penetrate it, use its own power to open the crack, and release the creature inside. Oh no, it was a bud.

After her repeated efforts, a seed finally sprouted in front of her eyes. Although it was very small and almost invisible to the naked eye, it did sprout and she could feel it.

"Hahahahaha."

Listening to the laughter coming from the room, the old cow swung its tail and cleared the dead grass faster.

After the first seed sprouted, the rest went much more smoothly and started to sprout one after another.

After the seeds sprouted sprouts the size of rice grains, Su Jinyue herself was extremely tired. Her energy was low. After this big move, she felt even more exhausted. She took back her natural power, stopped paying attention to the sprouting seeds, and began to lie down and study the system.

The unfinished business tugged at her sleepy mind.

"Wake up."

Su Jinyue turned over, and the cold air that came in through the gap gave her a jolt, and she woke up!

The cucumbers have arrived and the seeds have sprouted, it’s time to open the shop!

What's a good name? Let's call it Moon Farm. It sounds nice.

Sometimes choosing a name is just a flash of inspiration. As for this flash, you don't care whether it is Zhang Fei or Zhuge Liang.

Click Submit, "It was detected that the host has no products for sale, and the store failed to open."

"It seems that this means that the cucumber bug cannot be stuck, so we can only rely on these seeds."

"System, are you there?"
